title: 3.1 Nice to meet you
unit_title: Meeting people and talking about them
unit_outcome: Introduce people and answer introductions, use the short forms of be, answer yes/no questions in short, compare ages, talk about languages, nationalities and jobs, describe people, say whose things are, give an address and say what you want to be.
goal: Introduce a friend (This is my friend Luis.) and answer an introduction (Nice to meet you. / Nice to meet you, too.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 3.1 Greetings and Names: A1 greets people and asks and gives a name (Hello. What is your name? My name is Ana.); A1+ 3.1 introduces one person to another. It adds no new grammar relationship: This is + my friend + a name presents a person (A1 2.5's This is for a thing, A1 1.11's friend), and the fixed replies Nice to meet you. and Nice to meet you, too. answer it. Sofia and Luis introduce each other to a newcomer in a café, and Ana and Diego meet him there.
prerequisite: A1 3.1 hello, goodbye, good morning and What is your name? My name is …; A1 2.5 This is …; A1 1.11 friend; A1 4.10 night, A1 4.11 see and A1 4.12 tomorrow; A1+ 2.4 What's; A1+ 2.1 goes to the gym/pool/office/park.
speaking_outcome: Say Nice to meet you as one phrase, meet and you joined (MEET-choo is fine), and too with a long u; stress friend and the name in This is my friend Luis. Do not require native-like speed.
